title: Black holes confirmed by light vs. by gravitational waves

source.name: UC Irvine stellar-mass black hole census; GWTC catalog
source.publisher: University of California, Irvine; LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA Collaboration

notes: Before gravitational-wave astronomy, only about a dozen stellar-mass black holes had been directly identified via light (X-ray binaries devouring a companion star), per the 2017 UC Irvine census widely reported by ScienceNews/BBC Science Focus. Listening for gravitational-wave collisions instead has confirmed 390 since 2015 (LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA GWTC-5.0, 2026).
